evidence.quote: This is a 3-year program consisting of 6 academic semesters.
All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year
The application deadline in the self-financed procedure is 15th June.
The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform - that you can reach here:
Applicants must have an English proficiency of at least B2 level as the program is fully taught in English.
a TOEFL test with a minimum score of 513 (Paper-Based).
an IELTS test with a minimum score of 5.5.
yes, admission is based on a high school certificate and online written and oral entrance exams in Mathematics.

note.fr: Un entretien et un examen écrit d'admission en mathématiques sont obligatoires.
note.en: A written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics is required for admission.

evidence.quote: Admission requires a high school certificate; and passing a written and oral entrance exam in Mathematics.

notes: The tuition fee of 7,000 USD/year is for this programme. The application deadline of 15th June is stated without a year and is listed as a recurring deadline; it is the deadline of the self-financed procedure. The programme page evidence only mentions English requirements; no French language requirement was found.
